_about: The six senders and their LinkedIn limits. build.py reads this file. Adi's decisions of 2026-11-05: all six are on the free plan now; Sales Navigator comes soon and doubles every number. Change linkedin_plan to sales_navigator per person when their upgrade is live, then run build.py again. Titles stay role based until the separate headline task writes new ones.
sending_days_note: Monday to Friday, in UK and Central European business hours (08:00 to 17:00 UK time).

tantra_ceilings._source: https://usetantra.com/use-cases/linkedin-outreach (read 2026-11-05): Tantra's default limits per LinkedIn account; they can be lowered, never raised. Tantra caps per account, not per campaign.

tantra_guidance._source: Same page, 'Limits by Account Type' (conservative operating ranges, not published by LinkedIn).
tantra_guidance.free: 15 to 20 connection requests a day, without a note; up to 100 a week; about 3 personalised notes a month (200 characters each); no InMail
tantra_guidance.sales_navigator: 20 to 30 connection requests a day; 150 to 200 a week; up to 100 messages a day; 50 InMail credits a month

free._connection_note: Free accounts get about 3 personalised notes a month, so every connection request on a free account goes without a note. The first message after acceptance carries the opener.

sales_navigator._source: Adi 2026-11-05: 2x every free number, InMail campaigns switch on. The InMail number is our recommendation.
sales_navigator._inmail: Sales Navigator gives 50 credits a month (about 2 a sending day), so about 2 a day go on credits and the rest only to Open Profiles, which use no credit. If the list has too few Open Profiles, drop to 2 a day.
